title: finding(governance): ui/scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs carries a second GOVERNED_APPROVERS that no CODEOWNERS row covers and no workflow enforces
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSXPDB46NVRepWVrL3

Found while reviewing PR #34671 (card #34626): L1 record 6940438711, D3. Not fixed there; that PR only aligns the copy's value.

Suggested-grade: p2 (an unguarded copy of the governed approver set; no live enforcement reads it today)
Suggested-domain: `domain:devx` (`ui/scripts/**`, `.github/CODEOWNERS`)

## What is there (`origin/main` 62d9d0d998 and later)

- `ui/scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:349` declares its own `export const GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, with a self-test pin at :1480. It is the nested `ui/` workspace's copy of the root guard `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`.
- `.github/CODEOWNERS` covers the root guard (`/scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`) but has no row for `ui/scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`; its `ui/` block (lines 56–63) lists `ui/docs/adr/`, `ui/.claude/`, `ui/AGENTS.md`, `ui/CLAUDE.md` and `ui/.github/workflows/` only.
- No workflow runs the copy: `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml` runs the root script; the copy is reached only through `ui/package.json` scripts `check:governed-queue-guard` (`--self-test`) and `governed` (`--test`).

So the approver set lives in two files, one of them editable without an approver's review and enforced by nothing. PR #34671 sets both to `['os-zhuang']` and pins each, but nothing keeps them equal after that.

## Fix direction (one of)

1. Retire the copy: point the two `ui/package.json` scripts at the root guard (or drop them) and delete `ui/scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, if no reader needs a `ui/`-local copy.
2. Keep it, import `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` from the root guard instead of declaring it, and add a `CODEOWNERS` row for the file.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Exactly one declaration of the approver set in the repo, or a pin test that fails when the two differ.
- [ ] Any file that declares or reads the approver set is under a governed `CODEOWNERS` row.
